summary: HUTCHMED filed a Form 6-K (press release) announcing positive Phase III data for sovleplenib in warm antibody autoimmune hemolytic anemia presented at the EHA 2026 Congress. The release details clinical trial results (durable response rate 66% vs 15% for placebo), but neither announces nor implies an M&A, restructuring, activist campaign, or any other special situation. The registrant is the issuer filing a routine clinical update. No deal terms, stake, or structural changes are stated. This is a standard operational disclosure—not a special-situation event. Map to equivalent press release under US rules; no watch item or arb angle.
